footer.tagline: The full 90, all in one place. Scores, tables, squads and history for the competitions you actually follow.
footer.copyright: © {year} ninety. Not affiliated with any league, club or federation.
footer.localTime: Kickoff times shown in your local time.
footer.sourceDemoText: Synthetic season generated for development. Results, players and lineups are not real.
footer.sourceLiveText: Today's matches are re-read every minute from licensed providers.

home.inPlay: {count, plural, one {# match} other {# matches}} in play — scores refresh automatically.
home.emptyToday: No matches in the tracked competitions today. Try tomorrow or pick a date.
home.emptyDay: No matches in the tracked competitions on this day.

match.lineupsLater: Line-ups are published about an hour before kick-off.
match.lineupsUnavailable: We do not hold the line-ups for this match. They come from a second source.
match.lineupsNoSource: No line-ups here yet — they come from a second source we are not receiving.
match.eventsUnavailable: We do not hold the timeline for this match — goals, cards and substitutions come from a second source, and it has nothing for this one.
match.disputed: Result under review: our sources do not agree on this scoreline.
match.timelinePending: Still being completed. The full timeline follows shortly after the whistle.
match.metaDescription: {home} v {away} in the {competition} on {date}: score, line-ups, goals and the full timeline.

league.gridNote: Every match played, home club down the side. A dot is a fixture still to come.
league.halvesLead: Every match here carries two scorelines: the one at the break and the one at the end. Subtract them and the second forty-five minutes of the season is a league of its own — where a club sits once a match has settled.
league.slopeMove: {from} in the table, {to} after the break
league.slopeAria: A line per club from its place in the table to its place in a table of second halves, for {n} clubs.
league.halfNote: Built from the half-time score of every match, by the same rules as the real table. No qualification places: half a match is not a season.
league.halfWonHint: {n, plural, one {# match turned around} other {# matches turned around}}
league.halfLostHint: {n, plural, one {# lead let slip} other {# leads let slip}}
league.halvesTooEarly: No half-time scores recorded in this competition yet.
league.raceLead: Where each club stood after every round, from the results themselves. Point at a line to follow one club.
league.raceAria: The position of {n} clubs after each of {rounds} matchdays.
league.raceNone: Nobody has moved in the last few matchdays.
league.raceTooEarly: The race needs a few matchdays behind it. Come back when this competition has played two rounds.
league.noMatchesYet: No matches recorded in this competition yet.
league.noTableYet: No table yet — nothing has been played in this competition.
league.intro: Every competition we follow, with the full table, fixtures, results, scorers and history.
league.metaDescription: {league} {season}: live table, fixtures, results, top scorers and past winners.
league.scorersProvider: The competition's own chart, from our data provider. Last checked {date}.
league.scorersCounted: Counted from the matches we have followed, so it can run short of the official chart.
league.assistsFromScorers: Assists among the players in the competition's scorer chart, so a player who creates goals without scoring them will not appear.

team.intro: Every club in the tracked leagues, plus the European sides they meet in UEFA competition.
team.arcAria: {name}'s position in the table after each of {rounds} matchdays, from {first} at the start to {last} now.
team.noHonours: No titles in the tracked competitions since records here begin.
team.description: {name}: fixtures, results, squad, table position and honours.

player.statsProvider: Goals and assists from the competition's own chart, kept by our data provider.
player.statsCounted: Counted from the matches we have followed, so it can run short of the official figures.
player.statsNone: We hold no figures for this player yet. Goals and assists come from a competition's scorer chart, which lists the players who have scored; minutes and appearances need a second source we are not receiving.
player.metaDescription: {name}, {position} for {team}: goals, assists, appearances and form this season.
player.matchesNoSource: No match-by-match record yet — it comes from line-ups.

errors.notFoundText: That page does not exist, or the club, player or match has moved.

about.title: For people who just want the score.
about.lead: Open ninety and today's football is already on the screen: who is playing, who is winning, and where that leaves the table. Yesterday and tomorrow are one tap away. Nothing to close before you can read a result.
about.here1: {count} competitions followed properly — every match, table, squad, scorer and past winner.
about.here2: The season whole, not just tonight: where every club has stood after every matchday, and the table of second halves on its own.
about.here3: Arabic and English, light and dark, quick on a phone and on a bad connection.
about.here4: ⌘K searches everything. Follow your clubs and they come first.
about.testing: Scores, fixtures, tables, squads and scorer charts are live for {competitions}. Not yet: line-ups, the goals inside a match, and the live minute clock. They arrive with the next data source.
about.sources: Matches and results come from licensed data providers. Everything built on them — tables, form, scorer charts, the season charts — is worked out here from the same results you can click on, so nothing on the site can disagree with anything else on it.
about.demoNote: This deployment shows a Demo data badge: real clubs and competitions, invented results and players, for development.
about.next1: Line-ups, goal scorers and the live clock.
about.next3: Knockout brackets for the European nights.
about.next4: Writing worth reading, from people worth reading.
about.name: A match is ninety minutes. The mark is a pitch from above — the halfway line, the centre circle, the spot every game starts from — and the prime after the name is the one on a match clock: 90′.

follow.followTitle: Follow {name} — their matches lead your home page
